Relay modifications:
- DeviceBuilder::with_packet_capacity configures every device packet channel
  and the reusable packet pool. Default remains 4000; values 1..=65536 are
  accepted and validated before allocation. The relay selects 64.
- Pool retention uses the configured packet count instead of VecDeque's
  allocator-dependent capacity.
- Deterministic unit tests cover bounds, retention, backpressure and cancellation.

The capacity is a per-channel/retained-pool count, not a process memory limit.
Packets currently in use, the bounded pre-handshake queue and transport buffers
also consume memory. Cryptography and WireGuard wire protocol are unchanged.
